name: EPIC 210973557
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 10.7 solar radii and 1.22 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,050 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.22 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,966 K at its surface.
